items.title: Sorry for the Long Trip
items.details:
Team: LA Clippers
Player: Cam Christie
Effect: The player drawn must be traded to the other conference before the deadline.

items.title: Chemistry Builds Wins
items.details:
Team: Boston Celtics
Effect: Off-court activities bring the drawn team together. Increase Offensive Consistency by 3 for its five starters for the next 3 team games, then reverse this event’s changes.

items.title: Can't Recover
items.details:
Team: New Orleans Pelicans
Player: Saddiq Bey
Effect: Select the injured player on the drawn team with the most remaining injury days. On his return, decrease Mid-Range and Three-Point by 2 for his next 10 appearances, then reverse these changes.
